clinical_trials.brief_summary: The goal of this clinical trial is to substantiate the effectiveness and safety of USPlus® DERM for self-perceived thinning hair compared to placebo in healthy men and women ages 25-65 over the course of six months of continued use. Participants will be asked to have attend three office visits, one phone call, have photos taken of their hair and answer questionnaires related to their thinning hair.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Glycerol 作為保濕劑可改善頭皮水合，間接支持毛囊微環境；Glycerol kinase 5 (GK5) 參與皮膚特異性脂質合成（SREBP 調控），缺乏 GK5 的動物模型出現脫毛表現。LPA6（lysophosphatidic acid receptor）可能涉及毛囊週期調節，glycerophospholipid 代謝為其上游路徑。然而，這些均為間接/基礎科學連結。
先天性毛髮稀少症伴粟粒疹為罕見皮膚基因病（KRT 基因相關），與 alopecia 評分相近可能反映模型在毛髮疾病叢集的整體評估，而非針對性機轉連結。

clinical_trials.title: Effect of Transcutaneous Auricular Vagal Nerve Stimulation on Chronic Constipation: A Randomized Controlled Trial
clinical_trials.brief_summary: The worldwide prevalence of chronic constipation (CC) is 15%, and women are more likely to develop the disease than men. CC have a significant impact on quality of life and increase the burden of national health insurance. The conventional medication treatments are primarily symptom-specific and have limited efficacy. Previous small sample study had shown the therapeutic potential of transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (taVNS) for irritable bowel syndrome with constipation (IBS-C).

relevance.reasoning: 試驗已終止，研究干預為耳穴迷走神經電刺激（非 glycerin），適應症為慢性便秘（非 IBS）。與 glycerin 再利用完全無關，可能為資料庫誤配。

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Glycerol 直腸給藥（甘油栓劑）有已知通便效果，但對 IBS 的腸道微生物調節、內臟過敏性、腸腦軸等核心病理機轉缺乏已知連結。現有試驗為耳穴迷走神經刺激研究，與 glycerin 無關。
單純性頭皮毛髮稀少症（CDSN 基因相關），與上述先天毛髮疾病評估相同，缺乏 glycerin 直接作用機轉。
瀰漫性圓禿為自體免疫性疾病（T 細胞介導毛囊攻擊），glycerin 無免疫調節機轉。評分偏高可能受 alopecia 知識圖譜鄰近性影響，而非真正機轉連結。
Glycerol 靜脈注射曾被研究用於降低顱內壓（ICP），偏頭痛的某些亞型（如與 ICP 相關）可能有間接連結。然而，對一般性偏頭痛，缺乏任何臨床或基礎科學支持。
基底型偏頭痛/腦幹先兆偏頭痛涉及後循環皮質擴散性抑制，glycerin 無已知針對此特定亞型的機轉。評分略低於一般偏頭痛，符合更特異性亞型的模型行為。
